checks.name: native_platform_matrix
checks.result: macOS arm64, Linux x64 and Windows x64 each passed all 11 native contract gates. The tested PR merge tree equals the implementation head tree.

checks.name: controlled_background_continuation
checks.result: Controlled child processes wait for their caller to release them, proving piped launch returns while work remains running; execution, recovery and receipt checks passed on each applicable native platform.

acceptance.criterion: 运行任务在执行前持久登记，绑定项目、工作、会话、执行器与唯一操作标识。
受管本地命令记录启动/结束、退出码及日志产物；调用会话退出后仍可查询结果。
相同操作标识不会重复执行；外部任务只登记可验证引用，不因 PID 存在或调用者声称成功认定完成。
恢复区分受管任务运行中、已成功、已失败、无法确认；每项有核实依据和观察时间。
核实命令不自动重跑或杀进程；完成结果与仍运行任务进入接续上下文，避免静默遗漏。
以真实短命令验证跨会话运行、结果收取、失败、中断未知和重复登记；保留原有 checkpoint/resume 行为。

limitations: Windows-specific caller pipe inheritance was corrected after the initial native failure. Initial failure evidence remains identified in the compatibility record and Actions history.
Unix-only fixture supervisor termination checks are not credited on Windows.
Native agent hook activation, full business E4 and a new npm/PyPI release remain separate steps.
